newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich placement not linked to one deal.
newsitem.headline: Zurich placement not linked to one deal.

text.p: Zurich Group said its $1 billion placement of capital securities to raise money for operations including acquisitions was not linked to a specific transaction.
A company spokeswoman declined comment on press reports that Zurich planned to acquire U.S. money management company Scudder, Stevens & Clark for around $1.5 billion, but told Reuters:
"Zurich is always looking for acquisitions in these segments or divisions where it could not grow by itself. This (issue) is for the growth of the whole group. That is all I can say."
Asked if the issue of 40-year securities was more a general way to raise funds than to finance a specific acquisition, she said: "That is correct".
